name: AGH University of science and technology
overview:
Founded in 1919, the University of Science and Technology AGH is one of the best and most renowned Polish universities.

The school has nearly 32,000 students and consists of sixteen faculties.

The Faculty of Computer Science, Electronics and Telecommunications includes key research areas such as information society technologies, cloud computing technologies, fast optical networks, global wireless communications Internet of the future, the Internet of Things and sustainable development, for example. embedded systems in electronics, industrial electronics, telemedicine, electronic system design, signal recognition, microwave techniques, optoelectronics, photovoltaics, sensor systems, spintronics and nanotechnology.

In the "Perspektywy 2015" university rankings, the Faculty of Computer Science, Electronics and Telecommunications ranked first in Poland in the "Computer Science" category and the second among the Faculties of Education in Electronics and Telecommunications.

Classes take place in modern, well-equipped classrooms and laboratories, for example at the AGH UST Computer Center, which became operational in 2012 - a building that has received numerous awards and accolades for its original architecture.

The faculty also offers activities in student research groups: KNE (student interest group in electronics engineering), SPECTRUM (signal processing) and BIT. Curricula tailored to the needs of modern industry, combined with high standards of education, offer graduates of the Faculty of Computer Science, Electronics and Telecommunications a real advantage in the job market and enable them to become valuable members of engineering teams working for international companies. located in Krakow, such as IBM, Cisco, Motorola, Delphi, Comarch, ABB, Nokia Solutions and Networks.

  • EPITECH re-registration dossier


2) Visa

  • For European students, a valid passport / national ID card is sufficient to travel to Europe (exception for the UK)
  • For non-European students or students with a non-European citizenship, please check the immigration office of the host country to verify the visa process and fees

Students in France can use this website:

https://www.diplomatie.gouv.fr/fr/


3) Insurance

For European Students

The European Health Insurance Card (CEAM) is nominative and individual.

It certifies your rights to Health Insurance in Europe.

To obtain your CEAM:

  • Log in to your Ameli account at least two months before your departure
  • It is free of charge and will be sent to your place within two weeks
  • You can also download it online

More information:

https://www.ameli.fr/assure/droits-demarches/europe-international/protection-sociale-etranger/etudes-etranger


For Non-European Students

You must register for private health insurance to cover your full stay.

Please check with your parents, bank, or any private insurance company for more information depending on the desired coverage.


French citizens only: Register via the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Ariane) platform to be aware of any news (terrorist attack, tsunami, earthquake…) in your host country:
https://pastel.diplomatie.gouv.fr/fildariane/dyn/public/login.html
accomodation:
More than 7,000 students live in 20 dormitories, making AGH UST Student Campus the largest student institution in Poland.

Located 1.5 km from the main square, a 25-minute walk from the most distant AGH faculty, there are dozens of tram and UI bus connections to all parts of Krakow.

All residents have free access to laundry and gyms (volleyball court, basketball court, football field, gyms and tennis courts).

If you wish to have a place in the dormitory AGH UST Campus, ritalicitalicber that it is mandatory to register at the following address:

https://akaditalicik.agh.edu.pl/

You will receive a confirmation from the dormitory campus with the address of your room on campus.

If you have questions about single or double rooms or other requests, please contact the campus dormitory office dds@ms.agh.edu.pl

More details about the rooms and prices are to be found HERE.
courses:
60 ECTS per year

30 ECTS per semester


Language of Instruction

  • You will take courses in English at the Faculty of Computer Science, Electronics and Telecommunications.
  • No official language test is required, but you must have a B2 level in English.


Academic Calendar

  • Semester 1: Early October to mid-February
  • Semester 2: End of February to end of June
  • An orientation week is planned in September — please check the academic calendar.
